name: Peaka
title: peaka.com
shortDescription: Peaka is a data integration platform designed to simplify data management for startups and SMBs. It integrates various data sources, including relational and NoSQL databases, SaaS tools, and APIs, allowing them to be queried as a single source. Peaka eliminates the need for traditional ETL processes, enabling real-time data access and integration. An example use case is a small tech company using Peaka to unify data sources and generate reports without costly infrastructure.
pros: Supports both SQL and NoSQL databases
cons: May require initial setup and learning
Potentially limited by the range of integrations
Dependent on external data sources' availability and performance
